scope: Only replacement market-1 C02/MKT1 operations with exact reviewed calldata and a common fresh ETA; no change to unrelated DAG edges

oldExecutionDependency.disposition: Retain for old operations; replacement path requires explicit new approval before this edge can be substituted

forbidden: Execute old C02 merely to avoid expiry
Reuse old Safe signatures, old SafeTx hashes or old operator authorizations
Treat the local fork approvals as genuine Safe confirmations
Release D4/D6 maintenance or activate trading by this amendment
failureRecovery: If scheduling, simulation, signature review or either subcall fails, stop. A reverted atomic Safe batch leaves both new operations queued and market absent; reconcile Safe nonce and public state before a separately authorized retry. Do not execute either operation alone.
